project: RLQAS Phase 2 Complete: Multi-RL Algorithm Support, HEA Search, and Autonomous Exploration
description: Complete Phase 2 implementation: Extend RLQAS system to support multiple RL algorithms (PPO, DQN), implement HEA architecture search, enable autonomous exploration of state-of-the-art RL algorithms, and provide comprehensive testing framework. This unified task builds directly upon Phase 1 integration (Phase1/006) and Phase 2 Task 001 foundation.

phaseDependencies.phase2_foundation: RLQAS_Phase2_001 (DQN implementation) - Already completed and available in ../001
phaseDependencies.prerequisite: Phase 1 must be fully integrated and Phase 2 Task 001 must be completed

overallGoal: Implement complete Phase 2 functionality in a single development session, producing a fully functional multi-algorithm quantum architecture search system with HEA support, experiment management, autonomous RL exploration, and comprehensive testing capabilities.

lih_10qubits.note: 2 electrons in 5 orbitals = 10 qubits (Jordan-Wigner mapping). active_space=(2,5) NOT (4,4) or (4,5).

lih_12qubits.note: 2 electrons in 6 orbitals = 12 qubits (Jordan-Wigner mapping). active_space=(2,6) NOT (4,6).

acceptance_criteria: Multi-algorithm comparison completes successfully on LiH with active_space=(2,5) 10 qubits
LiH active_space=(2,5) 10 qubits test MUST assert energy_error < 1.6e-3 Ha (chemical accuracy) with Jordan-Wigner transformation - test must FAIL if this threshold is not met
LiH active_space=(2,6) 12 qubits test MUST assert energy_error < 1.6e-3 Ha (chemical accuracy) with Jordan-Wigner transformation - test must FAIL if this threshold is not met
HEA search produces chemically accurate results on LiH active_space=(2,5) with EXPLICIT assertion energy_error < 1.6e-3 Ha
Framework correctly identifies which algorithm uses fewer excitation operators with quantitative comparison
Runtime environment adaptation successfully enhances Tencirchem parity support
All Phase 2 components integrate correctly and maintain >90% test coverage
Comprehensive test report generated with performance benchmarks
CRITICAL: All chemical accuracy assertions use assert statements (not just print/log), so tests actually FAIL when accuracy is not achieved

notes: This PRD combines all 6 Phase 2 tasks into a single unified implementation plan
Task 001 code already exists and should be verified and integrated first
Key innovation is Task 005: Autonomous RL exploration with runtime adaptation
Focus on comparing which algorithm achieves chemical accuracy with fewer excitation operators
Maintain backward compatibility with Phase 1 throughout implementation

CRITICAL - Molecule active space notation: LiH (n_electrons, n_orbitals) where n_qubits = 2 * n_orbitals under Jordan-Wigner. active_space=(2,5) -> 10 qubits; active_space=(2,6) -> 12 qubits. Do NOT use (4,4) or (4,5) which correspond to different electron counts.

CRITICAL - Chemical accuracy tests: All integration tests for LiH molecules MUST use assert statements to verify energy_error < 1.6e-3 Ha. Tests that only print or log the error without asserting are INVALID and do not satisfy acceptance criteria.
